Description: Determines, damage, ,, stamina, cost and, draw time, with Bows (skill).

Introduction. Bows (skill) is a skill related to Bows weapon class.

Effects. Higher skill level in bows reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33%, increases damage and knockback up to +141% and reduces draw time up to -80%.
